prompts.parts_rack: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated individual modular game prop for the same underground cyberpunk pixel-art safehouse set: charcoal steel, muted slate gray, restrained cyan and amber accents, hard square pixel clusters readable at 48x48 logical pixels. Orthographic top-down RPG view with small visible front face, no isometric diagonals. Entire object centered, genuinely transparent background, no scene, no floor, no letters, no logos, no character, no external shadows. Minimal transparent margins. A compact industrial spare-parts shelf, width:height 1.3:1, three shelves with organized dark gray electronic modules, two small steel storage bins and coiled cable, small amber indicators, broad readable shapes. One coherent shelving unit.
